current.text: He is a 22-year-old rookie. Miami drafted him 37th in the 2026 draft.
He scored 17.5 points per game in Summer League before Miami sent him home early.
Experts say he looked good in Summer League.
Miami lost guard depth and ball handlers in trades. Davion Mitchell is the starting point guard.
He is not in Miami's projected starting five of Mitchell, Thompson, Wiggins, Giannis and Bam.
Experts expect him to get rotation minutes early in the season because Miami is thin at guard.
Dru Smith is injured. He could play ahead of Smith to start the season.
One expert would not be surprised if he becomes better than Davion Mitchell by the second half of the season.
Experts call him a name to watch, mainly in deeper and dynasty leagues.
Giannis may run point for Miami, which can take ball handling from the guards.
With the March 28 end, Miami plays 4-3-3 in the fantasy playoffs, 10 games, a weak schedule. Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs and none in the fantasy playoffs.
